name: @opsydyn/foldkit-viz-py
description: The foldkit-viz Python package: an anywidget that draws a plot spec in Jupyter, with its JavaScript bundled from foldkit-viz.

scripts.build: bun build js/widget.ts --outfile dist/widget.js --format esm --minify && cp ../foldkit-viz/schema/plot-spec.schema.json dist/
